title: Held whole-operation choice with serial DAIIN application and finite fusion
summary: EXPLORATORY_UNSELECTED: X selects unknown partial operation F_X; each DAIIN applies it to the current state and forwards its result. X D D means serial self-application, X D Y D composition, finite XD one application. One common rule on existing143sourcegroups; no identified operation, outcome or global grammar.

design.scope: Same132IT2a groups on fullf45r/f89r1.6-10 plus existing complete11-groupf115r.17; four full paragraphs plus one exposed line. No new corpus/image/reserve. Three-reader local spans retained from existing packets.

grammar.free: X daiin^n, n>=1: choose F_X once, then perform n serial applications. Only the selected pure DAIIN runs are interpreted; mixed marker runs and other text are unknown.
grammar.adjacent: X daiin Y daiin: pure selection of F_Y does not reset the current state; second application receives first output when source seam is definite and no unread group intervenes.
grammar.bound_extension: A finitely licensed bound head+DAIIN begins the same run; a following free DAIIN would apply the same held function again. Such a bound-plus-free doublet is a declared consequence, not a native example supplied by this packet.
grammar.others: No general suffix stripping. QODAIIN/CHODAIIN/OTYDAL stay whole; DAIN/DAIR/DAN/DAIIIN receive no operation. All uninterpreted groups and source boundaries stay visible.

semantics.types: One abstract state domain S; each selected complete descriptor X supplies one unknown partial F_X:S->S. Partiality permits operation preconditions and undefined composition; no silent totality assumption.
semantics.step: If F_X(s) is defined, append an application event and set current state to its output. Otherwise the proposed run is not executable at that input.
semantics.same_form: The same whole descriptor denotes the same F_X in every selected construction; different written descriptors may denote the same actual function. DOL and DAL strings remain distinct; no assumed functional inequality.
semantics.two_applications: F_X(F_X(s)), not two unrelated calls from s. Two calls do not require two effects or different final states.
semantics.two_heads: F_Y(F_X(s)); reversed order gives F_X(F_Y(s)), but noncommutation is not guaranteed for unknown functions.
semantics.finite_fusion: LicensedXdaiin is one F_X application, with one source group retained. This remains a finite writing hypothesis, not confirmed morpheme identity.
semantics.unread_intervals: No state threading through unread intervening text or unresolved source boundaries. Each subsequent local chain has an unbound boundary-state input, not a claimed reset/refill/no-op.
semantics.resources: No resource instance is created by the parser or by a new source name. A selected operation may have unknown physical effects; none is assigned. Old R_TOKEN remains invalid for its own fixed resource-consuming semantics.
semantics.old_anchors: All five Q2 source-anchor sites are preserved as prior-interpretation provenance only, not active resource identities in EXEC. Function choice uses the head descriptor, so latest-mention choice no longer decides it. This gives up those semantic obligations; it is not an empirical improvement. Four old marker relations remain uninterpreted.

assumptions: Operation-selection versus execution split is newly proposed, not observed word meaning.
One shared state type and partial endofunction typing for the selected heads.
Same descriptor fixes operation identity; no particular transformation or state value chosen.
Local head lookup is pure and adjacent outputs feed later inputs.
Every repeated DAIIN contributes one application event; none silently deleted.
Finite bound expansions only; known different-reader splits/annotations retained.
Source order used within safe interpreted spans, not invented whole-page process chronology.
All143groups preserved,123outside operation spans unexecuted; no global execution or final-state claim.

decision_note.unknown: Can one finite, explicitly typed selector/application rule retain all three observed forms and their complete source context without deleting repeated markers or treating unknown text as no-op? Intended state effects and marker meaning remain unknown.
decision_note.smallest_work: One small source-aligned authored trace over12applications in11constructions, a clear whole-context rendering, finite illustrative function tables and an independent source/type/serial-link audit. No new corpus scan, experimentGDT, general parser or operator search.
decision_note.outcomes: If coherent, retain an unselected execution framework with exact type/reference costs and observable-outcome gap. If source/type/sequence contradiction occurs, preserve it without per-occurrence repair. Neither branch selects a word meaning or justifies reserve access.
